component.name: Local Save Switcher
component.summary: Multiple playthroughs for your PC games

description.p: Keep several playthroughs of the same PC game: pick the one you want, LSS loads its saves and starts the game. It works with Steam, Epic Games, GOG and Heroic games, and with any game you add by hand; it finds where each game keeps its saves. A simple mode with one tile per game is made for families and the Steam Deck.
